title: Clean up the topic labels

labels.name: meta
labels.description: Changes to the ecosystem around the standard, not its contents

body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

I looked at how the `topic:` labels are used. The data was issues since 2020 and normative PRs merged since 2020, with each one mapped to the multipage spec pages it links to or changes. Some labels look dead or duplicated, and some busy parts of the spec have no label. Proposed changes:

Retire:
- [`topic: appcache`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/topic%3A%20appcache): 1 open issue, last used in 2018, and the feature is gone. (Maybe fix the remaining issue before removing the label.)
- [`topic: html modules`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/topic%3A%20html%20modules): no open issues, last used in 2020.

Merge:
- [`topic: cross-origin-opener-policy`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/topic%3A%20cross-origin-opener-policy) and [`topic: cross-origin-embedder-policy`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/topic%3A%20cross-origin-embedder-policy) into `topic: cross-origin isolation`. They're the pair most often applied together. Fetch might want the same label.
- [`topic: hyperlink`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/topic%3A%20hyperlink) (14 open issues) into [`topic: link`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/topic%3A%20link) (41), renamed `topic: links`, to cover `a`, `area`, `link` and link types. Both are mostly about links.html.
- [`topic: fieldset`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/topic%3A%20fieldset) (8 open issues, no PR since 2018) into [`topic: forms`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/topic%3A%20forms).
- [`topic: location`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/topic%3A%20location) (4 open issues, never on a PR, last used in 2021) into [`topic: navigation`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/topic%3A%20navigation).
- [`topic: worklets`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/topic%3A%20worklets) (4 open issues) into [`topic: workers`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/topic%3A%20workers), renamed `topic: workers and worklets`.

Rename or split:
- [`topic: timing`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/topic%3A%20timing) into `topic: timers and user prompts` (timers-and-user-prompts.html) and `topic: performance timing`, since it's used for both.
- [`topic: document.open()`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/topic%3A%20document.open%28%29) to `topic: dynamic markup insertion`, covering `document.open()`/`write()` and the `innerHTML` family (dynamic-markup-insertion.html).

Add:
- A label per element category for the element pages, which have no topic label that fits: `topic: sections` (sections.html), `topic: grouping content` (grouping-content.html), `topic: text-level semantics` (text-level-semantics.html) and `topic: document metadata` (semantics.html). Elements that already have a label (`a`, `link`, `style`, `ruby`) keep it, and conformance things keep [`document conformance`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/document%20conformance). semantics.html alone accounts for about 40 merged PRs with no clear label, and sections.html has no topic label on any of its issues.
- `topic: mathml`, for the MathML parts of embedded-content-other.html, which has no label.
- `topic: messaging`, for `postMessage`, `MessageChannel`, `BroadcastChannel` and `MessageEvent` (web-messaging.html and comms.html), which are currently filed under [`topic: serialize and transfer`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/labels/topic%3A%20serialize%20and%20transfer). That label would keep structured cloning only.
